description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldDateTimecombo, a widget for handling date-time combo fields in SuiteCRM, extending the base SugarWidgetFieldDateTime class. It includes methods for constructing the widget and generating query filters for date-time ranges.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldDateTimecombo
classes.description: A widget class for date-time combo fields in SuiteCRM, providing filtering capabilities based on date-time ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget and retrieves the reporter attribute from the layout manager.
